paragraphs: Landis+Gyr sells metering systems and grid software to utilities, and its homepage frames the work as connecting data, devices, and decisions. The metering line is described as advanced metering systems for utilities that deliver real-time data and grid visibility. Other listed offerings include communication networks, coordination of energy resources across the grid, and digital platforms for monitoring energy performance.

The company names utilities, cities, and energy-driven industries as the groups it partners with. A case study on the same site describes a shared network between a city water utility and another utility.

On the digital energy management page, the portfolio is described as interoperable, cloud-agnostic solutions rather than a single product. That page also describes a security architecture protecting data, devices, and communications from edge to enterprise. Support services are described as spanning deployment, integration, and ongoing system optimization.

quote.text: Connecting data, devices, and decisions around the world
